rationale: Round 0 compiled and ran correctly, so the budget permits pushing obfuscation strength up. FLA gets the highest SecurityGain/DiversityGain because control-flow flattening is the strongest structural defense for this program's recursive backtracking core (Trial/Place/Remove), while its RuntimeCost of 0.50 keeps it off the hottest inner loops where the dispatch overhead would hurt. BCF is kept high on security but with the largest Runtime/Size penalties (0.55/0.50) so bogus arithmetic blocks concentrate in cold functions of this tiny 3857-byte binary rather than inflating it everywhere. IBR and ICALL stay moderately enabled to break static branch/call-graph recovery with contained overhead, SUB and SPLIT are cheap, low-risk layers applied broadly, and IGV remains a light diversifier of global state access. Overall the table trades a modest, bounded runtime/size increase for substantially higher reverse-engineering resistance while keeping CorrectnessRisk penalties low, preserving the round-0 correctness result.
